contents.name: Identifier
contents.description: Composite Modbus address "<RegisterType>:<PDU offset>" of the datum to be read (e.g. "HoldingRegister:100", "Coil:5", "InputRegister:0", "DiscreteInput:12"). RegisterType is one of Coil, DiscreteInput, HoldingRegister, InputRegister; the offset is the 0-based PDU address of the Modbus specification, not the vendor 1-based/5-digit numbering some device manuals print (e.g. holding register 40101 in a vendor manual is "HoldingRegister:100").

contents.name: Datatype

enumValues.name: BOOL
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Boolean. Valid only with Coil/DiscreteInput addresses (1 bit).

enumValues.name: INT16
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Int16. 1 register, transported to the agent as Int32 (4 bytes) - pair with Encoding INT32.

enumValues.name: UINT16
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.UInt16. 1 register, transported to the agent as Int32 (4 bytes) - pair with Encoding INT32.

enumValues.name: INT32
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Int32. 2 consecutive registers, combined per the stream's WordOrder.

enumValues.name: UINT32
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.UInt32. 2 consecutive registers, combined per the stream's WordOrder.

enumValues.name: FLOAT32
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Single (IEEE 754). 2 consecutive registers, combined per the stream's WordOrder.

enumValues.name: FLOAT64
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Double (IEEE 754). 4 consecutive registers, combined per the stream's WordOrder.

contents.description: Wire-type hint for the address (e.g. "FLOAT32") - Modbus has no self-describing type system. BOOL is valid only with Coil/DiscreteInput addresses; the numeric types apply to HoldingRegister/InputRegister addresses and determine how many consecutive 16-bit registers are read (1 for INT16/UINT16, 2 for INT32/UINT32/FLOAT32, 4 for FLOAT64). A mismatch (e.g. FLOAT32 on a Coil address) is rejected by the source.

contents.name: WordOrder

enumValues.name: HighWordFirst
enumValues.comment: The register at the lower address holds the most-significant 16 bits.

enumValues.name: LowWordFirst
enumValues.comment: The register at the lower address holds the least-significant 16 bits.

contents.description: The vendor-specific register order used to combine multiple consecutive 16-bit registers into 32-/64-bit values (e.g. "HighWordFirst"). The Modbus specification fixes byte order within one register but not word order across registers - this must match the target device's convention.

contents.name: ReadCycleInterval
contents.description: Per-stream poll interval in seconds (e.g. 10). Falls back to the device twin's DefaultReadCycleInterval when unset.
